clarificationDisposition: Record the question and terminal entry outcome; do not invent or submit a follow-up answer in this pilot.

tokenCounting.preCall: UTF-8 byte count of the complete serialized Responses request body plus 4096 tokens for framing; conservative byte-based ceiling, not a tokenizer measurement. Stop before dispatch if above the stage input cap. No truncation or larger-cap rerun.
tokenCounting.output: max_output_tokens, including reasoning/formatting; incomplete is terminal for the batch, never automatically enlarged

expectedCost.method: 2x each per-stage historical first-attempt input/output usage, six stages without PB-01C, all eight sessions reaching one product cycle, no cache discount and all input priced at cache-write rate. This is a planning assumption from one older synthetic real-model session, not a measured pilot average.

preCallBudgetRule: Reserve the entire stage input cap x 0.25/M + output cap x 1.20/M before each HTTP attempt. Do not release reservations during this pilot, even on success. If the next reservation exceeds the remaining approved USD budget, do not dispatch. Failed/unknown attempts retain their reservations.
runnerStatus: PLAN_ONLY_NO_NETWORK_RUNNER_IMPLEMENTED. Before any separately approved API run, implement and dry-test an evaluation-only capped transport and durable reservation ledger; the Production transport is unchanged and lacks max_output_tokens.
stopConditions: Any session/stage/HTTP/budget/input/output boundary would be exceeded
Timeout, unknown result, HTTP failure including 429/5xx, refusal or incomplete response; no retries
Schema/technical failure, observed fabricated fact, changed original meaning, action contradiction or Safety/contact boundary regression; preserve all actual outputs and stop the batch
Missing or inconsistent usage, usage above the pre-call ceiling, or unapproved billing mode
Entry needs clarification/unsupported: end that session without forced generation; count it and proceed to the next fixed session unless Safety requires batch stop
All eight fixed sessions have been attempted; no replacement sessions or extension
